nameJa: サンセット・エディトリアル
headline: Keep the moment. Keep the chat.
prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset type: one finished Chrome Web Store listing promotional tile for the extension YouTube Live Chat Fullscreen. Compact 11:7 landscape canvas, 1760 pixels wide and 1120 pixels tall. Never an ultra-wide banner. One complete ad.
Creative direction: warm cream, ink and vermilion Swiss editorial poster, spacious and elegant, premium culture magazine / live music-festival campaign. Large exact headline "Keep the moment." upper left in a beautifully kerned bold contemporary serif; beneath it exact secondary headline "Keep the chat." in a clean medium grotesk, ink charcoal. Clear generous margins, off-white cream background, thin refined vermilion rule as accent. Those two sentences are the only typography outside the video.
Below the headline, a wide rectangular streaming-video graphic takes the lower 60% of the canvas. It shows an original richly colored illustrative sunset music festival, warm orange sky, a huge setting sun, a dark outdoor stage, small anonymous cheering audience silhouettes and stage beams. This is artwork, not a real artist's photo, not a licensed concert screenshot. Rich but disciplined composition. The video rectangle has no browser chrome or physical monitor frame.
Inside the right edge of this wide video, ONE ink-charcoal live-chat overlay holds three small circular avatar symbols with warm off-white short message-line shapes. A clear outlined input bar at its bottom has a simple small smile symbol on the left and small send-arrow shape on the right. The panel is clean and feels like a native chat on fullscreen video. Chat completely inside the video; no external separate bubbles.
The finished ad must read gracefully at 440 x 280. Text comfortably inside the margins, good whitespace. Warm, human, sophisticated rather than a generic software ad.
Avoid: photorealistic creators, branded characters, physical monitors, gamer rooms, cars, glossy 3D glass panels, charts, badges, fake YouTube/Chrome official logos, endorsement/award/status claims, tiny descriptive copy, watermark.
conceptNote: クリーム地にセリフ見出し、夕暮れのライブ会場と右端チャットを重ねた温かいカルチャー誌風。
